title: SSP-1.2 — Verification And Transfer Evidence
summary: final focused, live Projects, hands-on, durable-transfer and omission evidence for the completed document-subject foundation
content_html:
SSP-1.2 — Verification And Transfer Evidence

Outcome

SSP-1 is complete. This temporary Roadmap note records delivery evidence; the maintained implementation contracts live in the durable owner documents linked below.

Subsequent decisions: Resolver Tokens were later retired before implementation. SSP-3 now owns explicit subject-link insertion, while Project State and SSP-5 continue to consume exact subject aboutness and semantic-token usage remains separate mention evidence. SSP-5 was later narrowed to public Work/Series doc_url[] payload publication and exact follow-through; public display belongs to a future Catalogue presentation delivery outside Sub-Scope Publishing.

Final Verification

  • 126 focused Python checks passed across normalized subjects, strict Projects assignment/import, source formatting, registered customisation, private/public sub-scope building, exact metadata mutation, external generated reads, lifecycle paths, identity-migration regression, and served static assets.
  • Two existing document-transfer planner/apply checks passed with ordinary no-subject source, proving Copy remains write-free at preview, produces loadable independent target documents, and completes one target build/search follow-through without subject eligibility.
  • docs_viewer_subscope_report_modules.py, docs_viewer_catalogue_token_modules.py, docs_viewer_metadata_info_view_modules.py, and docs_viewer_service_manage.py --subscope-only passed. These retain Work/Series-filtered Catalogue reuse, passive Info, exact-target service composition, quiet routine assignment success, and visible assignment errors.
  • Explicit lint passed for 17 changed Python production/test files and four changed JavaScript production files. The maintained source-lint profile passed all seven checks with summary var/admin/test-runs/20260804-220453/summary.md. Repository whitespace validation passed.
  • The real external dotlineform/projects generation contains 241 normalized rows: 230 Folder, one Work, and ten None. Its 194 subject associations share the exact Manage receipt; one subject currently maps to 14 documents. A focused dry-run reports every document, manifest, and association output current.
  • Hands-on acceptance assigned a real work_id, observed the exact Catalogue cue and accessible Work context, and accepted removal of the routine global Updated authoring_subject success message.

No-Inference And Lifecycle Evidence

The normalized reader consumes canonical front matter only. A focused regression supplies Work/Series/folder-looking title, filename, body, route, selected-row, report-host, and UI-state values while leaving front matter subject-free; the normalized state remains None and the association set remains empty. Exact Manage locations are composed only after explicit valid identity exists.

Zero-to-many unit evidence groups two exact document targets under one Work subject and excludes malformed state. Builder evidence covers None, valid Folder/Work/Series, malformed/conflicting evidence, final association clearing, generic private collection reading, leading-zero identity, non-viewable rows, and public-readonly output. Existing create/import, Copy, viewability, and publication boundaries remain subject-independent.

Durable Transfer

  • Sub-Scope Customisation Architecture owns normalized state, identity rules, subject_generation, docs_subject_associations_v1, exact targets/locations, access boundaries, browser composition, code authority, and verification references.
  • Management Operations owns the exact revision-bound None/Folder/Work/Series mutation, strict fields, Catalogue reuse, unavailable/invalid resolution, source formatting, quiet success, and error behavior.
  • Info Panel owns passive exact-detail None/Folder/Work/Series/invalid presentation and its separation from assignment and row cues.
  • Scope Lifecycle owns the optional private association artifact and public-readonly lifecycle separation.

SSP-2 requires matching Manage/association generation and now traces exact Folder, Work, and Series subjects into scanned Folder rows. SSP-3 reads one normalized containing-document subject only when the author invokes Insert subject link; it does not consume private associations. SSP-4 transfers canonical raw fields rather than derived subject products and retains explicit ownership of the future analysis/works action. SSP-5 derives public Work/Series URLs from final public-eligible subject front matter rather than private Manage associations or semantic usage.

Independent Review And Retained Owners

The reviewed product commits are d1f76fd31 for SSP-1.1 and 9b40285f6 for the quiet routine assignment follow-up. The final diff retains one source normalizer, one registered Projects assignment group, one private association product, current exact-location composition, one Projects Manage contribution, and the existing atomic source-write/exact-rebuild transaction. Folder meaning remains registration-specific; Work/Series reading remains collection-independent; strict mutation remains separate from non-blocking read evidence; public projection completes before private composition.

At this checkpoint, subject-driven public Work/Series doc_url[] plus page presentation were assigned to SSP-5. The subsequent decision above supersedes only that presentation ownership: SSP-5 retains payload publication, while a future Catalogue delivery owns public display. Project State remains SSP-2-owned, explicit subject-link insertion remains SSP-3-owned, exact collection Copy and creation of analysis/works remain SSP-4-owned, and Studio Works retains curator-facing coverage presentation. A downstream consumer must match generation receipts before joining private products and must retain private/public location separation. A future subject shape or association schema change must update the normalizer, generation receipt, exact readers, durable architecture, and focused checks together.
